Input.description: A native `<input>`; any `type` works and every attribute is passed through. Inside a FieldRoot it is the field's control: labelled and described by the field's parts, named and disabled with it, and validated by it.

props.value: The input's value. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the input.
props.defaultValue: The value at first, when the input isn't controlled. The first value is also the input's `value` attribute: what a form reset puts back.
props.onValueChange: Called with the new value on every input, and once when a form reset changes an uncontrolled input.

dataAttributes.data-invalid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.
dataAttributes.data-valid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and passed.
dataAttributes.data-touched: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the input has been focused and left.
dataAttributes.data-dirty: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the value differs from the one it started with.
dataAttributes.data-filled: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the input isn't empty.
